title: Product states and entangled states
objectives: Distinguish entanglement from uncertainty in local outcomes.
prerequisites: Chapters 3–5: tensor products, complex amplitudes, unitary gates, Born probabilities and measurement bases.

quizzes.question: Which pure state is entangled?
feedback: It factors into two local pure states.
It is already written as a product.

quizzes.question: Can the determinant test classify an arbitrary mixed preparation from a Z histogram?
options: Yes, every correlated histogram is entangled.
No: it tests a specified pure-state column.
feedback: Classical preparations can have correlated records.
